# Filter rows where laps < 75

# Check if all such rows have a 'time / retired' value that does NOT contain a colon (indicating a time format like "1:47:35.5")
# Times contain colons, while retirement reasons do not.
# We'll check if any row in below_75 has a 'time / retired' that contains a colon.
has_time = below_75['time / retired'].astype(str).str.contains(':', na=False)

# The claim says: "any driver below 75 laps care trouble of some kind thus no time listed"
# This implies that for drivers below 75 laps, the 'time / retired' column should NOT list a time (i.e., should not contain a colon).
# So we need to verify that NO driver below 75 laps has a time listed (i.e., all have retirement reasons without a colon).
# Therefore, if any driver below 75 laps has a time (colon present), the claim is false.
any_has_time = has_time.any()

# The claim is true if no driver below 75 laps has a time listed.
answer = not any_has_time
